Analysis

Theme

From wars between states to wars inside them

Civilians, women, children and sexual violence were almost absent before 1999. Women now appear in 59% of resolutions and civilians in 38%. The median resolution grew from 234 words in 1960 to 1974 to 1,865 in 2011 to 2021.

The growth in length reflects multidimensional mandates: a peace operation resolution now lists tasks on civilians, human rights, elections, sexual violence, children and the rule of law. When each new agenda arrived.
